sources.label: SQL file
sources.expressiveness: The Ptah DDL parser subset for the selected dialect.

sources.label: YAML file
sources.expressiveness: Ptah YAML schema objects and their documented dialect overrides.

sources.label: HCL file
sources.expressiveness: The documented Atlas-compatible HCL subset plus named Ptah extensions.

sources.label: DBML file
sources.expressiveness: DBML tables, columns, keys, indexes, relationships, and supported notes; not every Ptah object.

sources.label: Go annotations
sources.expressiveness: The native annotation model, including Ptah-specific objects that narrower interchange formats may omit.

sources.label: External program
sources.expressiveness: Exactly the SQL, HCL, or YAML format declared by --schema-format.

sources.label: Configured external source
sources.expressiveness: Exactly the SQL, HCL, or YAML format declared by the selected external_schema block.

sources.label: OCI artifact
sources.expressiveness: The lossless canonical HCL document stored in the artifact.

sources.label: Live database
sources.expressiveness: Objects and attributes the selected database reader can measure from that server.

sources.label: Migration directory
sources.expressiveness: The schema produced by ordered replay on a disposable dev database.

sources.label: Composite source
sources.expressiveness: The union of the selected sources; conflicting definitions fail instead of silently choosing one.
